name: Fontainhas
why_included: Generally quiet and sunny; on Infatuation's work-cafe guide (Sep 2026).

name: Sit & Wonder
why_included: Cozy with plenty of outlets and a backyard garden in warm months.

name: The Bean (2nd Ave)
why_included: Laptop-friendly with outlets and long hours; tables packed close; staff may nudge long stays.

name: Black Cat LES
why_included: Reliable WiFi, abundant outlets, six couches plus a four-top; printers available.

name: Think Coffee (Tribeca)
why_included: Large space, outlets beside many tables, ~15-seat communal table up front; group-friendly.

name: Overflow Coffee
why_included: Lots of light, fast wifi, outlets everywhere; kids' play area kept separate; three sources.

name: Williamsburgh Library
why_included: Historic branch with reservable meeting rooms; fully accessible; open to 8pm Tue/Thu. Group via room booking.

name: PAC NYC lobby (Perelman Performing Arts Center)
why_included: Lobby free and open to public 8am-11pm daily with restaurant/bar; suggested by locals as a work spot. Laptop policy unconfirmed.

name: 590 Madison Avenue Atrium (former IBM atrium)
why_included: Glass bamboo atrium; required 32 movable tables and 110 chairs; free wifi and cafe per Untapped; 8am-10pm. Group.

name: Bloomingdale Library
why_included: UWS branch with a bookable 2nd-floor Study Room (reserve a timeslot); useful for small-group sessions, verify capacity.
